lessonPractice.title: 一位第一次访问的用户打开产品官网，需要马上知道产品解决什么问题以及下一步做什么。首屏怎样组织更有效？

options.label: 用明确标题和说明讲清价值，突出一个主要行动，并配必要的产品画面
options.feedback: 标题、说明、行动和画面共同服务于首要理解，用户能判断产品是否相关并继续。

options.label: 使用抽象口号和大幅装饰图，把具体能力留到页面底部再解释
options.feedback: 画面可能醒目，但新访客无法从首屏判断产品负责什么，也不知道是否值得继续。

options.label: 把客户标志、全部功能、三档定价和 FAQ 一起塞进首屏
options.feedback: 信息都重要不等于都属于首屏；过多并列内容会冲淡最主要的价值和行动。

en.title: A first-time visitor opens a product site and needs to understand the problem it solves and what to do next. How should the hero work?

options.label: State the value in a clear heading and explanation, emphasize one action, and show the necessary product view
options.feedback: The heading, support copy, action, and visual serve one primary understanding so visitors can judge relevance and continue.

options.label: Use an abstract slogan and large decorative image, explaining the actual capability near the page bottom
options.feedback: The composition may be striking, but new visitors cannot tell what the product does or whether to continue.

options.label: Place customer logos, every feature, three prices, and the FAQ together in the hero
options.feedback: Important content does not all belong in the hero. Too many parallel messages dilute the primary value and action.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请重做官网首屏：标题直接说明产品为谁解决什么问题，补充说明讲清结果，突出一个主要 CTA，并用真实产品画面提供证据。不要把功能、定价和 FAQ 全塞进首屏；用 5 秒扫读测试能否复述产品价值。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Redesign the site hero: state who the product helps and what problem it solves, clarify the outcome in support copy, emphasize one primary CTA, and use a real product view as evidence. Keep features, pricing, and FAQ in later sections, then run a five-second comprehension check.

practice.title: 这个网页里，哪一块是 Hero？
practice.instruction: 点击网页中的一个区域。选择后会显示它的名称，并说明它与 Hero 的区别。

initial.title: 先观察整个页面
initial.feedback: Hero 通常紧接在顶部导航下面，是当前页面最主要的介绍区域。

options.label: Header / Navbar
options.feedback: 这里放品牌、主要导航和登录入口，负责告诉用户可以去哪里。Hero 通常紧接在它的下面。
options.title: 这是 Header / Navbar
options.html: MeetFlow功能　示例　价格　登录

options.label: Hero
options.feedback: 它用主标题、补充说明、主要行动和产品画面，集中介绍当前页面最重要的内容。
options.title: 对，这一块是 Hero
options.html: MEETFLOW AI会后不用手动整理纪要上传会议录音，自动得到结论、待办和可继续修改的纪要。上传一段录音会议纪要本周需要确认的三件事产品演示时间设计稿确认客户回访安排

options.label: Social Proof
options.feedback: 客户标志和用户证据用来建立信任，通常接在 Hero 后面，但不属于 Hero 本身。
options.title: 这是社会证明

options.label: Features
options.feedback: 这里继续解释产品有哪些能力。Hero 先讲主要价值，功能区再展开具体能力。
options.title: 这是功能介绍区
options.html: 01自动整理从录音中提取结论02识别待办把行动项分配给成员03继续编辑保留原始内容并随时修改

en.title: Which part of this page is the Hero?
en.instruction: Select a region to see its name and how it differs from the Hero.

initial.title: Look at the whole page first
initial.feedback: The Hero usually sits directly below the top navigation and introduces the page's main point.

options.label: Header / Navbar
options.feedback: It contains the brand, primary navigation, and account entry. The Hero usually begins below it.
options.title: This is the Header / Navbar

options.label: Hero
options.feedback: Its headline, explanation, primary action, and product visual introduce the page's most important value.
options.title: Correct — this is the Hero
options.html: MEETFLOW AITurn every meeting into clear next stepsUpload a recording to get decisions, action items, and an editable summary.Upload a recordingMeeting summaryThree items to confirm this weekProduct demo timeDesign reviewCustomer follow-up

options.label: Social Proof
options.feedback: Customer evidence builds trust and often follows the Hero, but it is a separate section.
options.title: This is Social Proof

options.label: Features
options.feedback: It expands individual capabilities. The Hero states the main value before Features explains the details.
options.title: This is the Features section
options.html: 01Automatic summaryExtract decisions from audio02Action itemsAssign the next steps03Keep editingRefine the original summary
